paragraph: In China, several siblings worked to build a new staircase up a steep mountainside. They constructed 430 stone steps by hand to help their elderly mother reach her home. Her youngest daughter remembers her mother holding their hands on the old mountain path when they were children. The new sky ladder makes the climb easier for her. The family is grateful for the path.

seed.summary: The children of an elderly Chinese mother have touched the hearts of millions by painstakingly building a new staircase by hand up the side of a mountain to help her reach her home more easily. Her youngest daughter said that she remembers her mother holding their hands down the old mountain path in her childhood,
seed.sourceTitle: Siblings Build 430-Step ‘Sky Ladder’ for Their Mother Who Refuses to Live in the City
